1.title: How Reddit’s designers build ultra-realistic prototypes with Figma + Cursor
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Reddit built Reddit Proto, an in-house prototyping harness that maps design system to production code via custom MCP; 700+ prototypes live; workflow: Figma annotation → Cursor edit → draft PR; real data instead of mocks; leadership review and handoff mechanics shown.

2.title: The New Full-Stack Designer
2.author: Y Combinator
2.hook: Shopify's design studio lead walks through his process on recent shipped work (admin redesign, Sidekick), a grass shader weekend project, and reviews five submitted websites focusing on motion, interactivity, and conversion patterns.

1.title: Instagram CEO Reveals Biggest Update Yet
1.author: Colin and Samir
1.hook: Adam Mosseri discusses Instagram's shift to long-form horizontal video, monetization mechanics for creators, ranking factors (watch time, engagement), carousel performance, and AI accounts/agents on the platform — with tactical detail on discovery and creator career viability.

1.title: Only AI Can Build the Next AI | Richard Socher
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Richard Socher on building Flint, an open-source coding model developed by autonomous AI researchers; covers recursive self-improvement via open-ended search vs. narrow goals, and the policy debate around self-improving AI.
